morbi.headline: Morbi shows demand recovery for premium tiles despite sudden propane gas cost shocks.
what_changed: Propane gas prices spiked by Rs 7,300 per metric tonne, pressuring kiln margins.
Major branded tile players reported strong Q2 and H1 earnings, signaling industry recovery.
stress_signals: Propane price increase of Rs 7,300/MT creates immediate margin pressure for propane-fired vitrified and wall tile kilns [2f37d34283cf]
improvement_signals: Kajaria Ceramics beat Q2 2026 sales and profit estimates [c28b87e03125]
Varmora Granito reported a 498% jump in H1 profit driven by premium tile margins, reflecting broader sector recovery [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c]
what_to_watch: Extent to which MSME tile producers can pass on propane price hikes to end buyers.
Capacity utilization rates across unbranded vitrified and wall tile MSME units.
Working capital line utilization and inventory days among smaller Morbi kiln operators.

surat.headline: Surat faces pre-Diwali diamond wage defaults and power-led textile production stresses despite technical textile progress.
what_changed: Diamond processing sub-segment hit by unit shutdowns, owner disappearances, broker frauds, and pre-Diwali payment defaults.
Textile units struggle with pre-Diwali power cuts causing estimated weekly output losses of Rs 300 crore alongside labor shortages.
Surat Diamond Bourse faces ongoing operational traction challenges 3 years post-launch, while exporters look to rebuild US market share.
stress_signals: Multiple pre-Diwali diamond unit defaults, owner disappearances, and over ₹20 lakh in unpaid wages for artisans [8cfd5e03a794, 8f729a2b282e, 402ab705574d, c8a89bd2019b]
Surat mill owner defrauded of Rs 1.69 crore in fabric delivery via broker assurance [25d6a0f6dbec]
Pre-Diwali power cuts threaten industrial output with textile sector facing estimated weekly losses of Rs 300 crore and curtailed market lighting [37c492915105, 5ae803461fe0]
Textile manufacturers encounter rising production costs, insufficient demand, and labor/artisan shortages ahead of Diwali [0bc3ac5bf041]
improvement_signals: Expansion into defence fabrics and an early-stage technical textile collaboration with Mercedes-Benz via MANTRA [3a4ce1852d7c, c4aec155608f]
Anticipated textile export opportunities driven by the India-New Zealand FTA [8e92d85d894d]
what_to_watch: Bank account cash flows of diamond cutting/polishing units ahead of Diwali for signs of unannounced unit closures or payment defaults.
Working capital utilization and electricity usage patterns in weaving and processing houses impacted by power cuts.
Commercial progress and order books in MMF technical textile diversification into defence and automotive segments.
